gloss: to appear; to emerge; to come into existence

definitions.gloss: to appear; to emerge; to come into existence
definitions.explanation: For something to come into view or into being, often something that was previously absent or unknown. Used for both physical appearances and the emergence of new phenomena.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出現|しゅつげん}した。
⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧、⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出現|しゅつげん}した。
examples.english: Suddenly, a large shadow appeared before my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビジネスモデル→ビジネスモデル：29260_bijinesumoderu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{出現|しゅつげん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: With the spread of the internet, new business models are emerging one after another.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb composed of {出|しゅつ} (out) + ⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧ (appear). Describes the appearance or emergence of something, often with a sense of significance or novelty. More formal than ⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新種|しんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出現|しゅつげん}する: a new species appears
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出現|しゅつげん}する: a problem emerges
- ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出現|しゅつげん}する: symptoms appear
- ⟦{出現|しゅつげん}{頻度|ひんど}→出現頻度：24681_shutsugenhindo⟧: frequency of occurrence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: to appear — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appear (on stage), to enter — for people or characters making an entrance
- ⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: to occur, to arise — focuses on the onset of events or phenomena
